claims.text: Medical mgnt: lubrication, artificial tears, or contact lenses
claims.quote: Medical management is often ocular lubrication, artificial tears, or contact lenses.
Botulinum toxin injection can also be considered in a patient with spastic entropion.

claims.text: Definitive Tx: surgery (or Tx of the underlying cause)
claims.quote: Definitive treatment is surgery to correct the inversion of the eyelid or treatment of the underlying etiology (eg, infection or inflammation) (1).
